item.title: LazyCodex AI Launches OmO Support for Codex Models
item.description:
LazyCodex AI Launches OmO Support for Codex Models

The LazyCodex AI project has introduced OmO (oh-my-openagent) support for Codex models, providing a streamlined setup for users. The development follows restrictions on Anthropic models, prompting a shift toward Codex.

#LazyCodex #AIagents #Codex #OmO #OpenSource #AIdevelopment
